title: Count Vowels
description: Write a Zig program that counts and prints the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u) in a given string.
hints: Strings in Zig are `[]const u8` and can be iterated with `for`
Use a `switch` expression to match vowel characters
Zig's `switch` can match multiple values with commas: `'a', 'e', 'i' => ...`
